notes.title: Sentenced VR Original Soundtrack Released!
notes.notes:
By popular demand I've released a wee soundtrack for Sentenced! 

It Includes a full length version of our cover of the folk song 'The Maid Freed From The Gallows' that was used in the trailer.
 
It's currently available on bandcamp, and will be coming to Spotify/Itunes/etc soon.

[url=https://samuelgordon.bandcamp.com/album/sentenced-vr-original-soundtrack]Listen on Bandcamp here[/url]

notes.title: Controls Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Improved the smooth move and smooth turning. Left controller is now used for forward/backward and strafing movement, and right controller for turning/pivoting. 
[*]Added some new custom bindings for Oculus Touch and Index Knuckles controllers.
[/list]

notes.title: Contract Signing Bug Hotfix
notes.notes:
I put out a potential fix for the contract signing bug. I haven't been able to recreate it on my end, so I'd appreciate feedback from players who were experiencing this to let me know if it's solved!
Thanks,
Samuel

notes.title: Launch Day Fix!
notes.notes: Made a small change so that the 'continue' option on the main menu loads the previous execution, making it easier to explore alternate endings without having to replay through the entire game every time.

notes.title: Sentenced VR Available Now!
notes.notes:
"It is only the man dwelling in isolation who is not forced to respond, through defiance or submission, to the commands of others." - Stanley Milgram

Sentenced VR is out now! This project has been a real labour of love for me over the the last three years, and I hope you find it to be as interesting, worthwhile, and thought provoking as I found making it. If you like it, please leave a review!

Thanks for playing!

-Samuel Gordon

notes.title: Sentenced VR Developer Livestream
notes.notes:
Hello,

I'm Samuel Gordon, developer of Sentenced VR.

Sentenced VR is a Virtual Reality exploration of the relationship between personal conscience and obedience to authority. As the game progresses, players will be asked to follow orders that become less morally justified, forcing them to confront how far they are willing to go when guilt conflicts with duty.

Join me for this livestream of the Sentenced VR Demo ahead of it's launch, followed by a Q&A.

Master the art of beheading, become an agent of authority, and enact a divine drama of justice, death, and redemption.

notes.title: Sentenced VR Demo Released!
notes.notes:
Welcome, Executioners!

I'm happy to announce that a demo of Sentenced VR is now available until launch (early this summer hopefully) for testing. Let me know what you think and if you have any feedback/bugs to report. You know the drill!

This project has been a real labour of love for me, I can't say how excited (and nervous) I am for people to start giving it a go.

Many Thanks,
Samuel
